description:
Scholarship overview

This RMIT project uses computer simulations to study membrane ion channels involved in neuronal signalling and brain function. Research may extend to how drugs affect these channels, with computational work connected to experimental collaborators in Australia and the United States.

Research Areas

  • Computational biophysics
  • Molecular simulation
  • Neuroscience
